name: PAN: Physics of Atomic Nuclei (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend a week at a top nuclear physics lab. You do experiments with FRIB scientists and learn how atomic nuclei connect to stars.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 in the United States.
pay_detail: No cost. Room and board on campus are included if you need them.
duration: About 1 week in late July (2027: July 18 to 23, planned)
deadline_text: The application is posted each December, due in early March. The 2027 deadline is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form on the FRIB PAN page when it opens in December. Two teachers write recommendations. Questions: constan@frib.msu.edu.
